svg.text: Dotnet · D33 · Timeouts while the database looks idle are pool waits
Idle SQL + app timeouts = held handles.
Raising Max Pool Size hides leaks.
Hold time is the real size
An HTTP call inside using starves waiters.
Pool timeout is not 'SQL is down'.
elapsed prior to obtaining a connection
-- fix: dispose, then size, then cap
Leaks and TX length before the cap.

text.tspan: Correlate pool waits with DB sessions
Raise pool only if DB has room
